MLX-3000 Series



The MLX-3000 series instruments fit stock 3 3/8" tank and handlebar mounts found on Sportster, Rocker and various Dyna models.

Choose a black or chrome bezel to start, then get lost in the 31 illumination colors; independently select colors for speed reading, message center information, bar-graph readouts and gauge labels, or choose from 12 preset themes! The message center below the main speed reading offers plenty of information and can be configured to show just what the rider wants to see. Gauge display automatically dims for comfortable night time riding and brightens to a high contrast mode for excellent visibility, even in direct sunlight.

Speedometer can be calibrated for custom-gearing situations and allows the user to select MPH or km/H in the setup menu.

To top it all off, the MLX-3000 series features Bluetooth technology for the available mobile app for both Android and Apple iOS devices. Easily access the setup and customization preferences with your smart phone or tablet!

  • 250 MPH (400km/h) speedometer 
  • Wrap around tachometer with adjustable shift point, can also display in digital numeric readout
  • Odometer with two resettable trip odometers.
  • Miles to service (user settable countdown) 
  • Hourmeter.
  • Clock (12 hour format)
  • Voltage readout with low voltage alert
  • Gear position indicator compatible with 4- 7 speed transmissions.
  • Indicators for check engine, security and cruise on/engaged (engaged only MLX-3000)  
  • Performance calculations include: 0- 60 time, high speed & high RPM recall, 1/4 mile time and speed
  • Machined aluminum housing and bezel
  • Choose from chrome or black bezel with non-glare scratch resistant lens

Made in the USA and backed by a two year warranty!

MLX-3000: 1995-2005 Sportster and 1995-2005 Dyna (Non-Fuel Injected models)

MLX-3004: 2004-2011 Dyna, 2004-13 Sportster and 2008-2010 Rocker (Fuel Injected models only)

MLX-3012: 2011- 2018 Softail, Blackline, 2011 Rocker & 2013-2017 Breakout
                   2012- 2017 Dyna Models- Streetbob, Superglide and Wideglide 
                   2014- 2024 Select Sportster Models 
                   2018- 2024 Fatbob Softail 

For Dyna Low Rider 2004-2011 or other applications which contain a pair of stock instruments, a replacement or modified dash panel is recommended to consolidate into this single instrument package.

See chart for specific model year break down.

Dakota Digital Instrument systems are shipped from the factory with "0" miles on the odometer. Odometer can be set by the installer multiple times within the first 100 miles of driving. In the event of an error or oversight, the odometer reading can be corrected at the factory for a charge of $20. Please contact Dakota Digital to arrange this service.
